errors.noToken: No access key added. Enter a GitHub token in the settings.
errors.invalidToken: The GitHub key is invalid or has expired.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub's request limit was reached. It will be retried after {at, time}.
errors.forbidden: GitHub denied access. Check that the key has the notifications scope.
errors.threadNotFound: This notification was not found on GitHub; it may have been deleted or your access removed.

token.label: Access key (classic token)
token.help: Create a classic token and tick the notifications scope. Notifications from private repositories may also need the repo scope. Fine-grained tokens do not support the notifications API.

markThreadRead.title: Mark notification as read on GitHub
markThreadRead.description: Marks the notification as read on your GitHub account too.
markThreadRead.done: The notification was marked as read on GitHub.
